question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Brave
solution:
The correct answer is: **Courageous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Brave"** refers to someone who is ready to face danger or endure pain with courage and without fear. (साहसी)

 
 
• **Example:** The brave firefighter rescued the child from the burning building.
 
 
 
• **"Courageous"** is a synonym for brave, meaning someone who shows bravery in the face of fear or adversity. (साहसी)
 
 
• **Example:** The soldier displayed a courageous act by defending his country under challenging circumstances.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of **"Brave"** is **"Courageous"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Courageous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scared** (डरा हुआ): Feeling fear or anxiety about something.

 
 
• **Example:** She was scared of the dark and refused to go outside at night.
 
 
 
• **Timid** (भीरु): Showing a lack of courage or confidence.
 
 
• **Example:** The timid kitten hid under the bed when strangers arrived.
 
 
 
• **Fearful** (भयभीत): Feeling or showing fear or anxiety.
 
 
• **Example:** He gave a fearful glance at the storm clouds gathering above.
